normalize_json_to_dataframe: normalize semi-structured JSON data into a flat pandas DataFrame with nested dict expansion
normalize_json_with_record_path: normalize JSON data extracting nested record paths and metadata fields into a flat table
flatten_nested_dict_to_record: flatten a nested dictionary into a flat dict with dot-separated keys for nested values
convert_json_list_to_line_delimited: convert a JSON array string into line-delimited JSON format
normalize_json_with_max_depth: normalize nested JSON data up to a specified maximum depth level
